decks.notes: The deck focuses on controlling the game with a mix of removal spells, counter spells, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler. The main win condition is Omnath, Locus of Creation, which can quickly overwhelm the opponent with its powerful abilities. The deck also includes cards like Solitude and Leyline Binding to deal with threats on the board. The mana base is built to support the multiple colors needed for the spells in the deck, ensuring consistent access to the cards needed to control the game.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively disrupt the opponent's game plan while using powerful creatures like Seasoned Pyromancer, Ragavan, and Dauthi Voidwalker to apply pressure. The inclusion of disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Terminate, along with cards like Grief and Fury, helps to control the board and keep opponents on the back foot. The deck also utilizes Feign Death and Undying Malice to protect key creatures and maintain tempo. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of disruptive spells and powerful creatures to secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay, utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Grief, and Fury to quickly disrupt the opponent while dealing damage. The inclusion of Thoughtseize, Terminate, and Feign Death allows for control and removal options. The deck also benefits from the synergies between Dauthi Voidwalker and cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Blood Moon to further disrupt the opponent's strategy. With a mix of hand disruption, removal, and aggressive creatures, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing Amulet of Vigor and bounce lands to generate massive amounts of mana quickly, allowing for explosive plays with Primeval Titan and Cultivator Colossus. The inclusion of Dryad of the Ilysian Grove enables additional land drops and fixes mana, while Urza's Saga provides additional value by tutoring for key artifacts like Amulet of Vigor. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with large creatures and potent land synergies, leading to swift victories through powerful combo plays.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent through direct burn spells while also utilizing aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Goblin Guide. The deck aims to maintain a fast-paced tempo and pressure the opponent, forcing them to react and ultimately win the game before the opponent can stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Boros Charm, Skullcrack, and Searing Blaze further enhances the deck's ability to deal damage efficiently and close out games quickly. This deck is all about aggression and relentless assault on the opponent's life total.

This deck aims to establish control over the game by utilizing a combination of countermagic, removal spells, and powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The key strategy revolves around protecting The One Ring, a powerful artifact that can dominate the late game. By efficiently managing resources and disrupting the opponent's game plan, the deck looks to outvalue and outlast opponents until The One Ring can take over and secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive plays using burn spells and efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Goblin Guide. The deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently, often finishing off the opponent with powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Spike. The inclusion of cards like Boros Charm and Skullcrack helps to protect the deck's threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes cards like Roiling Vortex to punish opponents who rely on lifegain or repetitive spells.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize a toolbox of creatures, such as Strangleroot Geist, Young Wolf, and Hapatra, Vizier of Poisons, to create a combo engine using cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide. Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution are used to search for key pieces of the combo, while Zulaport Cutthroat and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse can provide additional value and win conditions. The deck aims to control the board with efficient creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan while assembling its combo pieces for a game-winning turn.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on early aggression and disruption. It aims to quickly deploy threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Dauthi Voidwalker. The deck also includes removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt to deal with opposing creatures. The inclusion of Undying Malice and Feign Death allows for additional combat tricks and recursion, while Blood Moon can disrupt greedy mana bases. Overall, this deck aims to apply pressure early and disrupt the opponent's strategy to secure a quick victory.

The main strategy of this deck is to control the opponent's every move through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing its own powerful board presence. Cards like Prismatic Vista and Snapcaster Mage provide versatility and recurring value, while The One Ring acts as a powerful late-game win condition. Overall, the deck thrives on denying opponents resources and dictating the pace of the game until it can secure a victory.

The deck focuses on a fast-paced aggressive strategy, utilizing efficient removal spells and powerful creatures to quickly overwhelm opponents. It also includes disruption in the form of hand disruption and graveyard hate to disrupt opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion allows for additional flexibility and consistency in the deck's mana base. The deck aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent, forcing them to react while maintaining a strong board presence.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through various removal spells and disruption effects, while also ramping up mana with cards like Cabal Coffers and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth. The deck also aims to utilize powerful planeswalker Karn, the Great Creator and creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to pressure the opponent. The inclusion of artifact hate and graveyard hate cards like Relic of Progenitus helps to disrupt opponent strategies, while cards like Profane Tutor and Invoke Despair provide additional utility and flexibility in the deck's game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize cards like Indomitable Creativity and Wrenn and Six to consistently create tokens and generate value. By combining different elements like Teferi, Time Raveler and Archon of Cruelty, the deck aims to disrupt opponents while setting up its own combos. The inclusion of cards like Leyline Binding and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional control and win conditions. Overall, the deck emphasizes a mixture of creativity, synergy, and disruption to overwhelm opponents and secure victory.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly cycle through your deck using cards like Street Wraith and Architects of Will to fill your graveyard with creatures, then cast Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield while your opponent likely has no creatures to defend themselves. The deck also includes disruption cards like Force of Negation to protect your combo. This allows you to overwhelm your opponent with a sudden influx of powerful creatures and potentially win the game in one big swing.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game through a combination of powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six, along with disruptive cards like Solitude and Leyline Binding. The deck aims to ramp up mana quickly using cards like Growth Spiral and Omnath, Locus of Creation, and finish off the opponent with big threats like Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines. The inclusion of cards like Prismatic Ending and Boseiju, Who Endures adds flexibility and resilience to the deck's strategy, making it a formidable force in a 1 vs 1 Modern format.

This UW Control deck focuses on utilizing powerful control spells such as Teferi, Time Raveler, Counterspell, Force of Negation, and Supreme Verdict to dominate the game. The deck also includes key support cards like Lórien Revealed, Leyline Binding, and Prismatic Ending to maintain control over the battlefield. With a diverse mix of cards for removal, card draw, and board presence, this deck aims to outmaneuver opponents through precise decision-making and strategic resource management. Additionally, the inclusion of Kaheera, the Orphanguard as a companion provides additional utility and synergy with the deck's game plan.
